main.description: One person joining one board. `board` is the at-uri of a net.bisks.tacocounter.board record; the board's member list is computed by asking constellation.microcosm.blue for every membership record whose `.board` points at it (public/lib/constellation.js), rather than a global scan — the aggregation mechanism that makes a board's leaderboard privacy-scoped to people who hold its link. Written and read by tacocounter (https://tacocounter.bisks.net).

board.description: at-uri of the net.bisks.tacocounter.board record being joined.

joinedAt.description: When this membership was created, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
